We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. What you'll build As a Senior Cloud-Native Engineer (f/m/d), you will build and scale the critical backend infrastructure for the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). Your work will directly impact how thousands of developers and global businesses create and run their applications. In this role, you’ll transform our cloud capabilities by taking ownership of services that are essential to SAP's strategy. Build and operate the highly-available, scalable microservices that form the backbone of the SAP Business Technology Platform. Architect and implement the central API gateway, handling massive-scale traffic, security policies, and observability for all of SAP's cloud products. Enhance our core Kubernetes infrastructure to provide a fast, reliable, and seamless deployment experience for developers using the SAP Business Application Studio. Take full ownership of the services you build, adopting a "you build it, you run it" philosophy. This includes everything from initial code to deployment and participating in on-call rotations to guarantee 24/7 service reliability for our customers. Elevate the team's technical capabilities by mentoring other engineers, driving architectural decisions, and establishing best practices. What you bring Degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 5+ years of professional experience in backend or platform engineering. Expertise in an object-oriented language like Go (Golang), C++, Java, or Node.js. Go is preferred. In-depth, hands-on experience with cloud-native paradigms, including container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, or similar. Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools for distributed systems such as Elastic Stack, Prometheus, Grafana, or Dynatrace. Experience deploying and managing applications on cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP. Fluent English language skills, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Beneficial Experience in computer networking concepts, and specifically with a massive scale of network traffic. Where you belong You will join our skilled engineering team located in Berlin and Israel. Our team fosters a highly collaborative and agile culture built on pair programming, test-driven development (TDD), and continuous delivery. This is a workplace where you will own services critical to SAP's success, work with cutting-edge open-source technologies, and grow your career alongside a supportive team of cloud experts. We are committed to your development and provide opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression. #SAPBTPEXCareers #LI-LS2 ​ Bring out your best SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. As a QE developer working on the SAP Concur Spend team, you will help to test, automate, scale, and extend SAP Concur Expense – from provisioning new customers to processing customer terminations, and all their experiences in between. SAP Concur Expense is the industry-leading platform used by a majority of global top 500 companies to reimburse their employees for expenses incurred while on the job. Our customers demand the best, and you will help make sure they get it by building quality gates between development and production. What you'll do: Passion for quality in all aspects: user experience, scalability, performance, and metrics. Work with developers to promote test-driven design patterns, making sure quality is a core consideration in everything we deliver. Create detailed test designs using both exploratory and scripted testing methods. Develop and execute manual and automated tests using a combination of industry standard tools and “home brew.” Learn our software inside and out, becoming a subject matter expert in the configuration and use of our software. Work in a scrum development project model, with a daily team scrum meeting, and weekly production deployments across multiple data centers, with automated post-deployment testing. Participate actively in requirements, design, and feature reviews. Work with global Spend QE, support, and product development teams located at other SAP locations such as Vancouver, Seattle, Israel, Germany, France, Prague, and Bengaluru. Be excited about keeping up with technology and changing tools, environments, and an agile engineering process where weekly deployments across multiple data centers world-wide is the norm. Enjoy a strong technical environment where all members of the development teams, including management, are close to the code, and making technical contributions. Potential to grow into one of the QA Release leads who drives a weekly release, or to move into one of our development teams. What you bring: Formal training in computer programming or a related technical field. The ability to solve technical computer problems by writing actual working code; this is very much a hands-on position. Demonstrated desire and ability to learn new technologies. Advanced written and verbal communication skills in English. Easy to work with and adaptable to change. Initiative and the desire to improve – yourself, our products, our working environment, and our processes. Familiarity with testing tools like JMeter, Selenium, Cucumber. Scripting/programming capability. Plan and tailor Max Success Plan engagements to customer needs, develop value propositions, secure customer alignment, and coordinate contracts while collaborating with account teams, solution experts, industry experts, partners, executives, and delivery support teams. Ensure high-quality execution of Max Success Plans, including governance, executive reporting, escalation management, resource planning, procurement, contract management, and service delivery. Coordinate engineering services and expert resources across end-to-end customer engagements, including design, optimization, assessments, technical integration, validation, operations, enablement, training, and workshops. Highly customer-service oriented with strong customer management capabilities. Ability to build trust-based relationships and strong networks across customer IT, business organizations, and the SAP ecosystem. Proven problem-solving skills and a strong work ethic. WORK EXPERIENCE 10+ years of hands-on experience with SAP Enterprise Solutions, Industry Solutions, Platform Solutions, SaaS Solutions, and Third-Party and/or Partner Technologies. Experience in SAP project management, value management, and quality management practices. Experience leading design, implementation, and change management projects. jobs.description: Recruiting Scams and Fraud | SAP Careers Recruiting Scams and Fraud | SAP Careers Skip to main content Language Deutsch (Deutschland) English (Global) Français (France) 日本語 (日本) 简体中文 (中国大陆) View Profile Language Deutsch (Deutschland) English (Global) Français (France) 日本語 (日本) 简体中文 (中国大陆) View Profile Language Deutsch (Deutschland) English (Global) Français (France) 日本語 (日本) 简体中文 (中国大陆) View Profile Please note that bogus websites and bad actors impersonate companies and perpetrate identity theft by sending “official” looking recruiting messages to jobseekers. Don't be fooled by a job offer or recruiting message that seems too good to be true. As part of our SAP recruiting process, we will never request money, credit card, bank account, personal financial details, passport, or other personally identifiable information. Initial contact from an SAP recruiter can begin on LinkedIn or via email from addresses ending in sap.com. All official correspondence such as interview scheduling and job offers will be sent from an email ending in sap.com. If you do feel you were victim of recruiting related fraud, please contact your local law enforcement responsible for identity theft or cyber-related crime.
